visible.author: Kevin
visible.title: Fitment
visible.body: Great parts! I have bought parts for several vehicles and the parts work great! Leveling blocks under struts.

visible.author: 5019E
visible.title: Worked Great
visible.body: This product did exactly what it said it would do and it was perfect for what I needed. I had a tire rub issue going on at full turn. Leveling the front end to the back end, did the trick. Truck is exactly level and rub issue is gone. I had a local garage install them. Took them less than an hour and all they charged was $100. Well worth having them do it.

visible.author: DanielA
visible.title: Really Easy
visible.body: Took me no more than a hour by myself to install. Really simple and instructions was easy to follow, prefer this style of level over the puck anyday.

visible.author: Liftem-up
visible.title: A little goes a long way
visible.body: This kit worked great to level the front of my trailboss 100% recommend. Anything bigger you will start to have a carolina rake setup with nose to high.

visible.author: Jose
visible.title: Will level the 3 inch factory on trail boss!
visible.body: It works to level the front on a 2020 Chevy trail boss 4x4.

visible.author: Ken
visible.title: Great Option
visible.body: Easy to install, brought the front end up right where I wanted it. I had no issues with the bolts being too short, as some have stated.

visible.author: kris
visible.title: Good unit
visible.body: Well so far so good. I installed and front end aligned been driven for few months. I was kind of worried it might have drivability problems but it's been good not notice any changes .

visible.author: Matt
visible.title: Great Parts
visible.body: It was fast and easy to install. Make my truck look amazing.

visible.author: John
visible.title: 2024 Silverado 2.7
visible.body: Instalation was easy truck looks great highly recommend

visible.author: Matthew
visible.title: Easy install
visible.body: The hardest part was getting the inside bolt to slide past the driveshaft, while lining up the holes. Taking driveshaft loose is necessary and still can pose a challenge.

visible.author: Jerinmichigan
visible.title: Leveling kit installed for 20" rims with 35" tires
visible.body: Along with 2.5" leveling kit at the top of the shock it will now fit the 35" tires with minimum rubbing

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Daddoesthings
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Won't work with 2023 Yukon XL
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Bolted up and fit. The problem is the front shafts boots were touching the shock mounts. If it was 2wd would have been fine.

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Isaacruehl
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Meh. Worth the money.
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Worth the money that I spent them. Sleek style and pretty simple to install.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: MotoFab 1.50-Inch Front Leveling Kit (04-27 2WD/4WD F-150, Excluding Raptor)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: DonB
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Not that easy
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Took a little longer to install than expected. Quality looks ok. Raised front about 2 inches.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: MotoFab 1.50-Inch Front Leveling Kit (04-27 2WD/4WD F-150, Excluding Raptor)
